consequence.statement: New optional capability to send custom headers when fetching configuration over HTTP; no operational consequence is stated.

original.statement: Traefik's HTTP provider now supports custom headers when fetching configuration over HTTP.

decision.reason: [ev-a4518986637f] lists this under "Enhancements" as new support for custom headers when fetching configuration through HTTP. That describes an optional new capability, and nothing in it says existing behaviour changes, fails or must be migrated. An environment that does nothing therefore has no operational consequence, so "none" (informational) fits. Confidence is low because the evidence only implies "no consequence" and does not state it outright.
